name: Pally
description: Text-message personal assistant with a hosted MCP server, so Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor can message your Pally and collect its replies. Backed by Y Combinator.

skills.name: Message Your Pally
skills.description: Send a message to your Pally assistant and get its reply, with long jobs returning a handle to check later.

skills.name: Check Pally Replies
skills.description: Use the handle from a long-running request to collect Pally's reply once the work is ready.
